Drawback: Stamina Drain.name: Drawback: Stamina Drain
Drawback: Stamina Drain.description:
🫁 Your Quirk runs on your own physical energy.

📉 You start with less stamina than most people.
⚠️ Once you push your Quirk, every use leaves you more winded.
🏫 You eat big meals, sleep long and tire early on long days.

📈 Grants: Stamina -15
Drawback: Stamina Drain.traitNarrativeEffects:
The Quirk burns the user's own physical energy; the stamina pool is smaller than average at all times. These stamina costs are this drawback's exception to the rule that Quirk use costs only Strain, and come on top of it.
Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): each further use also costs brief stamina; the user breathes hard, sweats and slows between uses.
Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; each use beyond light also costs demanding stamina; legs shake, grip weakens.
Quirk Strain 100: the body runs dry; the user drops to their knees or blacks out for a moment, losing extreme stamina, and the Quirk gives out until Strain falls below 60.
The signs fade as Strain falls back below each threshold.
Ordinary life: eats large meals, sleeps long, tires early on long days and training, and has a smaller reserve than friends assume.
